liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Alligator** (2 reviews): Early show Alligator is great, with theme changes and scary Feedback; Jam after drums teases China Cat and Bid You Goodnight before Alligator [7][13]
- **Morning Dew** (1 other source): Mickey's gongs make universe-shredding sounds throughout the Morning Dew early set [19]
- **Mason's Children** (1 review): Jam at the beginning of Mason's Children is special due to Pigpen's harmonica [11]
- **The Other One** (1 review): The Other One is described as being for the ages [8]
- **Uncle John's Band** (1 review): Uncle John's Band starts rough but comes together nicely [7]
- **In The Midnight Hour** (1 review): In The Midnight Hour is recommended for lifting spirits [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1970-01-03.sbd.lai.6642.sbefail.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 37 songs; 172 min; rated 3.83/5 by 6 [1]. Said about its sound: This copy has much better sound quality than the highly reviewed one [17]
- **gd1970-01-03.sbd.gmb.97743.flac16**: soundboard; 32 songs; 172 min; rated 3.25/5 by 4 [2]
- **gd70-01-03.sbd.ret.19440.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 28 songs; 172 min; rated 4.68/5 by 19 [3]. Said about its sound: Soundboard sounds very good for the time period with good singing and playing [9]
- **gd1970-01-03.137559.sbd.miller.flac1648**: soundboard; 26 songs; 171 min; rated 2.67/5 by 3 [4]
- **gd1970-01-03.138811.late.sbd.gastwirt.miller.sirmick.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 15 songs; 111 min [5]

## Around the show

- Band delivered high energy despite cold New York weather, opening with Morning Dew [6]
- TC played organ, having split the band the night before New Orleans [14]
- Five Pigpen songs performed for a NYC Fillmore East crowd [15]
- Reviewer prefers this show over the previous night, even without Dark Star [6]
- Show is tighter than the previous night but lacks a Dark Star [13]
- This recording is considered a better copy than the highly reviewed version [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1970-01-03.sbd.lai.6642.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Mike Lai and Wayne Gucwa; source: BD > MR > DAT > C > DAT > CDR [1]
- **gd1970-01-03.sbd.gmb.97743.flac16**: transferred by Bill Koucky; source: Soundboard Master Reels > DAT Master [44.1] [2]. Also: Minor L-R adjustments made in Morning Dew, Me & My Uncle, Big Boss Man [2]
- **gd70-01-03.sbd.ret.19440.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD:MR> DAT> Cass.> DAT > CDRPLUS:1. Sound improved on d1t02 (Me & My Uncle)2. SBE's corrected and checked, new md5's generated. [3]. Also: Early show includes Alligator jam leading into Caution and Feedback [3]
- **gd1970-01-03.137559.sbd.miller.flac1648**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Master Reel > Cassette > Dat (48k) [4]. Also: High Time false start occurs after I Know You Rider; Cut in That's It For The Other One at 18:18 [4]
- **gd1970-01-03.138811.late.sbd.gastwirt.miller.sirmick.sbeok.flac16**: taped by From Gastwirt Collection; transferred by Charlie Miller and SIRMick; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source: sbd > 1st gen reel > dat (48k); provided by Rich Gastwirt; Transfer: Dat > Panasonic SV-3700 > Tascam DA-3000 > wav 16/48; transferred… [5]. Also: Digital problems patched using SBD, Master Reel, Cassette, and Dat lineage [5]
